summary: Vermilion Energy Inc., a Canadian oil and gas producer, announced via Form 6-K filing on May 6, 2026, that it signed a deal to acquire producing assets in Germany, adding about 1,000 boe/d (85% natural gas) of low-decline production. The acquisition increases exposure to European TTF-linked gas and Brent-linked oil, enhances excess free cash flow, and improves control of gathering infrastructure near the Osterheide well. Terms such as price per share, premium, and advisors were not disclosed. This is a bolt-on asset purchase; watch for regulatory clearance and integration updates.
